newsitem.title: BULGARIA: NO DEALS STRUCK ON BULGARIA BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: NO DEALS STRUCK ON BULGARIA BOURSE.

text.p: No corporate stocks traded on the Sofia Stock Exchange (SSE) for a twentieth day in a row and the RABSI (Reuter All Bulgaria Stock Index) was unchanged from Thursday's 41.31 points, brokers said.
No repo deals in treasury paper were struck on the SSE today either, said brokers. There were no repo deals there on Wednesday as well.
The other local bourse, the Bulgarian Stock Exchange (BSE) will resume trading on Monday after a one-month summer recess. -- Dessislava Popova, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
